links.outcome: LLM accuracy, comprehensiveness and safety on NCCN-guideline PDAC clinical questions, including critical errors
links.effect: o1-preview accuracy 75% vs 60% for ChatGPT-4o; both made critical errors in complex scenarios and caused some potential harm to patients.
links.quote: However, both models made critical errors in some complex clinical scenarios.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the raw performance, accuracy, and safety of two LLM models (ChatGPT-4o vs OpenAI o1-preview) on clinical oncology questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
